title.zh: 保留余项的部分展开与真实位置接续
title.en: Partial unfolding with residuals and resumption at reached positions

statement.en: Carrying out a recipe part of the way leaves a recipe remaining where the course stands: resuming it completes the recipe, and carrying the recipe to the end is a partial course leaving nothing. Moves inserted before resuming join into one course, and can disable what remains.
statement.zh: 部分执行一个配方，在路径所在处留下余下的配方：续行余项完成配方，执行到底恰是不留余项的部分路径。续行前插入的动作接成一条路径，并可使余项失效。

laws.en: For any frame and recipe (nothing, a move, a test where the course stands, one recipe after another, or a choice of two), one advance takes a move, passes a test, drops a finished first part, advances a sequence's first part or takes one side of a choice. Carrying a recipe out part of the way, a course of advances, leaves a recipe remaining at a configuration, and is a course of the frame's own moves.
laws.zh: 对任一框架与配方（空配方、一个动作、在路径所在处的一个检验、一个配方接另一个，或二者择一），一次推进是取一个动作、通过一个检验、丢掉已完成的前段、推进序列的前段，或取选择的一侧。部分执行配方（一串推进）在某构型留下余下的配方，且是框架自身动作的一条路径。

laws.en: Resuming what remains from where a partial course stands completes the recipe, and a recipe leads from s to t exactly where carrying it out from s can leave nothing remaining at t.
laws.zh: 从部分路径所在处续行余项即完成配方；配方从 s 通向 t，恰当从 s 执行它可在 t 处不留余项。

laws.en: A partial course, moves of the frame inserted from where it stands, and a resumption of what remains from where those moves led join into one course of the frame through their actual boundaries; the inserted moves are not thereby part of the recipe.
laws.zh: 部分路径、从其所在处插入的框架动作，以及从这些动作所到之处续行余项，经其实际边界接成框架的一条路径；插入的动作并不因此成为配方的一部分。

laws.en: A partial course from a configuration is matched from any alike configuration of another frame, leaving the same recipe and ending alike, with no premise; from a configuration passing the same branching tests it is matched, ending where the same tests pass, given excluded middle as a hypothesis and the outcomes of the second frame's moves listed.
laws.zh: 自某构型的部分路径，自另一框架中任一相似构型被匹配，留下相同配方并相似地结束，不加前提；自通过相同分支检验的构型，在以排中律为假设、第二个框架动作的结果可列举时被匹配，结束于通过相同检验之处。

laws.en: Configurations passing the same branching tests answer every recipe question alike: a recipe leads from one to where a test holds exactly where it does from the other, with no premise and no finiteness.
laws.zh: 通过相同分支检验的构型对每个配方问题回答相同：配方从一者通向某检验成立之处，恰当它从另一者也如此，不加前提，不需有限性。

laws.en: A description of what remains together with where the course stands, exact for resumption (equal codes resume to the same tests), gives different codes to two such configurations that resume differently.
laws.zh: 对余项连同路径所在处的描述，若对续行精确（相等编码续行到相同检验），则给续行不同的两个这样的构型不同编码。

laws.en: In Midway, from safe, the recipe that begins and then finishes where finishing can be taken reaches done, while the recipe testing at the start whether finishing can be taken does not.
laws.zh: 在 Midway 中，从 safe 出发，先 begin、再在可 finish 处 finish 的配方到达 done，而在开头检验能否 finish 的配方则不能。

laws.en: In Midway, carrying out the choice of begin then finish, or begin alone, from safe can stand at ready with finish remaining or with nothing remaining; with finish remaining the course can reach where finish cannot be taken, with nothing remaining it cannot, so every description exact for resumption codes the two apart.
laws.zh: 在 Midway 中，从 safe 执行“begin 后 finish，或只 begin”这一选择，可停在 ready 而余 finish，或停在 ready 而无余项；余 finish 时路径可到达不能 finish 之处，无余项时不能，所以对续行精确的每个描述都以不同编码区分二者。

laws.en: In Midway, finish inserted at ready reaches done, from where the finish still remaining cannot be taken, so an inserted move can disable what remains; ready and done do not pass the same branching tests.
laws.zh: 在 Midway 中，在 ready 插入的 finish 到达 done，从那里仍余的 finish 不能进行，所以插入的动作可使余项失效；ready 与 done 不通过相同的分支检验。

laws.en: The earlier witnesses on the periphery's granularity unfolding: testing before formation changes the result; one start leaves the residuals finish and nothing at one reached position, and every exact presentation of the paused answers codes them apart; and an inserted finish can disable the pending finish.
laws.zh: 外围粒度展开上的较早见证：在形成之前检验改变结果；同一起点在同一到达位置留下余项 finish 与空余项，暂停答案的每个精确表述都以不同编码区分它们；插入的 finish 可使待用的 finish 失效。

hypotheses.en: Recipes are finite (moves, tests, sequences and choices), carried out by the supplied advance semantics; a partial course is a finite course of advances. Tests are branching tests of the frame, not physical operations shown to be available.
hypotheses.zh: 配方是有限的（动作、检验、序列与选择），按给定的推进语义执行；部分路径是有限的推进路径。检验是框架的分支检验，非已证明可用的物理操作。

hypotheses.en: Matching partial courses takes one recipe on both sides and alike starts, or, with excluded middle as a hypothesis and listed outcomes, starts passing all the same branching tests, stronger than agreement at block boundaries; resumption after inserted moves starts where those moves actually led.
hypotheses.zh: 匹配部分路径要求两侧同一配方与相似的起点，或在以排中律为假设、结果可列举时，起点通过全部相同的分支检验，强于块边界上的一致；插入动作后的续行从这些动作实际所到之处开始。

does_not_show.en: Translation of what remains between recipes of different internal syntax is not shown: matched courses carry out one recipe on both sides.
does_not_show.zh: 不表明内部语法不同的配方之间余项的翻译：被匹配的路径两侧执行同一配方。

does_not_show.en: How a formation actually comes to remember or sense what remains is not modelled.
does_not_show.zh: 不模拟形成实际如何记住或感知余项。

does_not_show.en: Recipes have no iteration, so unbounded iteration is not covered.
does_not_show.zh: 配方没有迭代，所以不涵盖无界迭代。

does_not_show.en: Concurrent activity and its admission are not modelled: inserted moves are a course of the same frame.
does_not_show.zh: 不模拟并发活动及其准入：插入的动作是同一框架的路径。

does_not_show.en: No uniqueness of a description of what remains is shown.
does_not_show.zh: 不表明余项描述的唯一性。

does_not_show.en: Configurations equal in the frame can differ in what remains; this implies no variable of reality independent of the one unfolding.
does_not_show.zh: 框架中相同的构型可在余项上不同；这不意味着有独立于同一展开的现实变量。

detail.zh: 同起点同原生到达位置留下不同余项；同一finish插入活动也能禁用待执行finish，而此前历史仍成立。
detail.en: One start and native reached position admit different residuals; the same inserted finish activity can disable a pending finish while preserving the preceding history.

next_delta.en: Translate what remains, tests and formation between descriptions with different internal syntax, telling semantic tests apart from tests a formation has actually acquired.
next_delta.zh: 在内部语法不同的描述之间翻译余项、检验与形成，区分语义检验与形成实际取得的检验。

correspondence.zh: 程序余项和原生条件是同一语义展开的分析坐标；不声明独立本体或相同完整物理状态产生不同未来。实际物理组织若已含余项，可不另设坐标。
correspondence.en: Residual recipe and native conditions are analytical coordinates of one semantic unfolding, not independent ontologies or identical complete physical states with different futures. A whole physical representation may already include residual organization.

detail.zh: 接用guard语义、执行路径及diamond问题等价。
detail.en: Consume guarded execution semantics, native paths and diamond question equivalence.

input.en: resumption_after_inserted_history retains the actual suffix; same_preserves_resumption preserves finite residual questions.

conditions.en: Actual reached conditions and supplied remaining recipe; the latter additionally needs complete native Same.

detail.en: Reuse finite successor recovery at each partial advance.

output.en: Equally answering positions have matching successors.

input.en: advance_matches and partial_history_matches retain common residual syntax.

conditions.zh: 原生完整问答及接收侧有限后继。
conditions.en: Complete native answers and receiving-side finite successors.

input.en: cut_sequence appends the same continuation to every residual.

conditions.en: Advance.seq supplies pointwise preservation; administrative paths and physical events are distinguished.

detail.en: Concrete cases reuse its single connected process; hiding failures behind completion is not recounted as a new general discovery.

history.zh: 2026-10-15，整合 I3b（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（Becoming.Granularity 的“余项”）。部分执行配方，在路径所在处留下余下的配方（Recipe.Leaves），这一记账是其自身的展开，不加动作（Recipe.Leaves.trace）；续行余项完成配方，执行到底恰是不留余项的部分路径（Recipe.Leaves.resume、Recipe.leads_iff_leaves）。自相同配置出发的部分路径相匹配并保留余项，不加前提（Recipe.Leaves.alike）；自同测配置出发，需列出结果与 em（Recipe.Leaves.same_of_em）。插入的动作与部分路径及续行接成一条路径，而不是配方的一部分（Recipe.Leaves.inserted）。见证 Midway：在到达处检验与在开头检验结果不同；同一起点在同一配置留下不同余项，任何对续行精确的描述都区分它们；插入的一步可使余项失效（Midway.testing_before_formation_changes_results、Midway.remainder_codes_apart、Midway.inserted_can_disable_resumption）。外围的 ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary.unfolding 以带重叠通配分支的匹配定义，编译后用 propext，故 ExplanatoryResumptionCases 的见证在核心的 Midway 框架上重述（同样六个配置、三个动作与六步）。桥接：外围的推进与核心的一一对应（Recipe.advance_ofProgram、Recipe.Advance.toProgram），截断即留下同一程序的部分路径（cut_iff_leaves）；cut_resume、execution_iff_completed_cut、resumption_after_inserted_history 逐字成立，partial_history_matches 以 em 为假设；same_preserves_resumption 不加前提（外围以经典推理把每个续行问题读作单一检验，核心读作有限多个）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 15 October 2026, integration I3b (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (what remains, in Becoming.Granularity). Carrying out a recipe part of the way leaves a recipe remaining where the course stands (Recipe.Leaves), and this bookkeeping is an unfolding of its own that adds no move (Recipe.Leaves.trace); resuming what remains completes the recipe, and carrying it out to the end is a partial course leaving nothing (Recipe.Leaves.resume, Recipe.leads_iff_leaves). Partial courses from alike configurations match, keeping what remains, with no premise (Recipe.Leaves.alike); from configurations passing the same tests they need listed outcomes and em (Recipe.Leaves.same_of_em). Inserted moves join a partial course and its resumption into one course without being part of the recipe (Recipe.Leaves.inserted). The witness Midway: testing where the course has arrived and testing at the start give different results; one start leaves different remainders at one configuration, which every description exact for resumption keeps apart; an inserted move can disable what remains (Midway.testing_before_formation_changes_results, Midway.remainder_codes_apart, Midway.inserted_can_disable_resumption). The periphery’s ExplanatoryGranularityBoundary.unfolding is defined by a match with an overlapping wildcard case and compiles through propext, so the witnesses of ExplanatoryResumptionCases are restated on the core’s Midway frame (the same six configurations, three moves and six steps). In the bridge, the periphery’s advances and the core’s correspond one to one (Recipe.advance_ofProgram, Recipe.Advance.toProgram), and a cut is a partial course leaving the same program (cut_iff_leaves); cut_resume, execution_iff_completed_cut and resumption_after_inserted_history hold as stated, partial_history_matches with em; same_preserves_resumption needs no premise (the periphery reads each continuation question as one test, classically; the core as finitely many). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope.

18 October 2026, F1, the bridge fold, step 3 (Ren: "please do all"): the restatement audit of step 0 (development/bridge-fold/RESTATEMENT-AUDIT.md) found ExplanatoryResiduals fully restated by Becoming.Granularity, and its importer ExplanatoryResumptionCases an earlier version whose witnesses Becoming.Midway restates. The canonical source is now the core module; both periphery files keep their path and bytes and stay cited as the earlier statement. The claim is unchanged.

Both periphery files keep their path and bytes, and their receipts stay bound. The claim is unchanged.
